feeds.title: Daddy Mojo
feeds.description: Daddy Mojo is a parenting blog about the adventures of a stay at home dad. We'll share some articles about being a better mom or dad, saving money, issues dealing with our children and poop culture.

feeds.title: Dad Blog UK
feeds.description: I am a married stay at home father with two young daughters. I write and make videos about parenting, fatherhood, lifestyle, food, travel and motoring etc. Gestation and Lactation; the only two things men can't do as parents.

feeds.title: Retire by 40
feeds.description: Posts on early retirement, frugal lifestyle, making money, real estate and stocks. Joe Udo wants to change the way you think about retirement. Retire by 40 is a place to share his aspiration for Financial Independence.

feeds.title: Gay NYC Dad
feeds.description: Stay at home dad blogger raising a tweenage son in New York City. I am in a same sex marriage and our son was adopted at birth. Their mission is to promote a healthy parenting lifestyle in America.

feeds.title: Going Dad
feeds.description: I'm a health conscious stay-at-home dad looking for products that keep us fit, happy, and healthy. Follow along as I share our experience and discoveries with my daughter as a side-kick.

feeds.title: Twigs and Brambles
feeds.description: I'm a speculative fiction writer and stay-at-home dad. I've had a number of stories and poems published over the past few years in a variety of venues. Prior to moving here and staying at home with my kids, I worked in experiential education (high ropes courses, teambuilding, climbing walls) and more traditional education as well as freelance writing.

feeds.title: Daddy's Turn
feeds.description: I'm Timothy. Over ten years ago I married Jolene. Together we love to travel and be adventurous. 5 years ago we had Johanna. Our family is growing this year with a baby boy. This site is dedicated to my adventures as a stay at home dad.

feeds.title: Bajadad Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Curtise Lewis's corner of the internet, where he proudly shares his journey as a stay-at-home dad, entrepreneur, and versatile problem-solver. Through his platform, Curtise offers insights, experiences, and a wealth of dad hacks, dedicated to supporting fellow fathers navigating the challenges of parenthood.

feeds.title: Days of a Domestic Dad
feeds.description: Days of a Domestic Dad features reviews, lifestyle, parenting and family content from a Dallas, Texas dad blogger. Living the daddy dream life one day at a time. As the father of 5 and head of the household, I am often looking for the next best thing when it comes to parenting. The post and updates here will include my daily adventures as a Domestic Dad.

feeds.title: Dad or Alive Blog
feeds.description: The confessions of an unexpected first-time stay-at-home Dad of 3 under 7.

feeds.title: Inside Martyn's Thoughts
feeds.description: A Single Stay at Home Dad juggling his way through Co-Parenting, Home Education, Muscular Dystrophy, Mental health and cooking!

feeds.title: Stay At Home Dad Gamer
feeds.description: A blog that reviews video games and talks about being a father of two young kids. Saving princesses to saving leftovers... Stay at home dad just trying to play some games!

feeds.title: Patrick L. Hempfing Blog
feeds.description: Former CPA turned Stay-At-Home Dad, International Columnist, Speaker, & Author of the Holding On series.

feeds.title: Mr Mum: The 'joy' of a stay-at-home dad
feeds.description: The adventures of a stay-at-home dad and his two kids. Created as a future memoir for my children when they are older, hopefully you will enjoy it.

feeds.title: Papa Shaun's Corner Blog
feeds.description: Stay at home Christian Papa sharing my spiritual and everyday life experiences, observations about current events, and our travels around the world.

feeds.title: Stay Home Dad and Son - Our Lives
feeds.description: This is a blog about a stay home dad and his son, who has Autism Spectrum Disorder (High Functioning). It is about their lives, fun, laughter, tears and joys, and random nothingness.

feeds.title: Stay Home PaPa
feeds.description: Stay Home PaPa is an informative daily chronicle following the day-to-day exploits of a stay at home father and his amazing daughter.

feeds.title: Daddy's in Charge?
feeds.description: A stay at home dad talks openly about his life and kids.

feeds.title: NashDads
feeds.description: NashDads is a group of Dads that meet weekly for their kids to play in Middle TN. Their members are Stay at Home Dads, Work at Home Dads & flexible schedule Dads.

feeds.title: Tuscan Dad
feeds.description: Hi everyone, and welcome to our blog! Well first of all we're really excited to tell you all about our life, and hope you enjoy reading about us! Hopefully we'll make you smile, laugh and with. Being a Stay at Home Dad...In Tuscany!

feeds.title: Dad@Home
feeds.description: Dad@Home follows author and full-time Dad, part-time blogger Gregory Tysowski's journey and life as a Stay At Home Dad. He reflects upon the major life changes and developments in his life. He also shares new updates regarding his book Dad@Home : Fully Domesticated here.

feeds.title: Cook at Home Dad Blog
feeds.description: Stay At Home Dad and Blogger Bill Roberts showcases his collection of original recipes, perfecting over years of trial and error. He loves cooking and is obsessed with creating healthy, nutritional recipes on a daily basis for friends and loved ones. Read healthy recipes and nutrition facts in the latest articles.

feeds.title: Not a Power Couple
feeds.description: Here you will find in-depth information and tools for moms and dads of all types. Not a Power Couple is a blog for Stay at Home Dads and Working Moms. Learn the best practices and insights on surviving as a stay-at-home dad or working mom and losing weight post-baby.

feeds.title: Foodness Gracious
feeds.description: Hi, I am Gerry Speirs and I am a stay-at-home dad with two kids to feed. It is not always easy but I always love to cook dinner every night for the family, and I want to pass my tips and favorite recipes to you!

feeds.title: GameplanAndGiggles.com
feeds.description: Parenting, Shopping, and Travel Tips from a Stay-At-Home Dad. The author is a former collegiate football player who now enjoys staying home with his son very much. He shares his daily experiences and his own insights learned from life in new posts every day.

feeds.title: Man vs. Pink Blog
feeds.description: UK dad blogger, chronicling the fun and games of a geek father, his fangirl daughter, and their ongoing struggle against pinkification. I'm a writer, blogger, campaigner, and influencer. I usually write about being a dad in a mums world, and raising a girl outside the gender stereotypes of the pink aisle.

feeds.title: Dashing Dad
feeds.description: Dashing Dad was created to share some of my adventures as a full-time Stay-At-Home Dad in Calgary. On this site I share some of our favorite things to do, places to go and people to see as well as stories of our daily life and lessons learned.
